source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB counterpart supplies the supported isolated channel-key lifecycle.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending key type/scope, vault injection, verification and rollback.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart classifies the isolated approved key change as REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats exact key/channel/tool as Project inputs; ED-35 preserves functional mutation; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Set or rotate one approved IPMI channel security key on an isolated test channel, verify effective authentication without disclosure, and restore or revoke it safely.
original_method: Use the vendor-supported channel-key command only through vault-backed secret injection with an independent recovery credential and explicit security approval.
manual_activity: Security owner defines and approves the key type/lifecycle; operator proves the independent recovery path immediately before the single key operation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects guessed keys; OOB history makes execution conditional on an approved vendor package and secret-handling path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Vendor-approved protected channel-key runner with vault/HSM reference and no secret material exposed to the review record.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture redacted channel/auth baseline, confirm isolated scope and recovery, inject one generated test key, verify authentication non-disclosively, then rotate/revoke or restore the approved state and audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a controlled functional workflow without editing the undefined Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Metadata/readback alone is not equivalent to effective authentication and lifecycle validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong key or channel can lock out management or create a credential incident.

project_override_considerations: Vendor API or raw command may be selected by Project SPEC only with equivalent secret isolation, effective auth and recovery coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master provides no key type, channel, encoding or criteria and asks to clear logs, which conflicts with credential-change audit requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended isolated key lifecycle and OOB implementation family are clear; exact vendor schema, vault, approval and recovery are readiness inputs rather than a permanent review contradiction.

review_improvement: Keeps functional key-change coverage while making secret non-disclosure, effective authentication, rotation and recovery mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: This high-risk credential mutation cannot be downgraded to read-only or run from TBD. With vendor schema, vault-backed injection, isolated channel, confirmation and recovery it is conditionally executable, so REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is appropriate.
